name: Red Chicken Enchiladas in Guajillo Chile Sauce with Crema (Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Plaza de Coco (Día de los Muertos Night 2)
whyItWorks: Shredded chicken in soft corn tortillas is gentle, but the red guajillo chili sauce and raw onion garnish trigger symptoms.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for plain shredded chicken rolled in corn tortillas with melted cheese only (no red guajillo chili sauce, no raw onions).
